_comment: Decision-search eval set: questions an agent asks, each with the decision ids that answer it. The corpus is the maintenance eval's seed decisions (neuralmind/memory/eval.py, _TASK_SEED_DECISIONS) plus the distractors below, which share its vocabulary (sqlite, index, tokens, log, server) so that ranking matters: the seed alone has 10 ACTIVE decisions, and a top-5 would be half of it. All of it is synthetic. Queries run with the default status filter (ACTIVE), so gold ids are ACTIVE decisions only. The queries were written and frozen before any search variant was measured; don't tune them to a variant. Run: neuralmind decisions eval --queries tests/memory/fixtures/decision_queries.json
_kinds: sentence = a question phrased the way agents send it; negative = nothing in the corpus answers it, so the right result is none; paraphrase = a question that shares no search word with its answer (tests/memory/test_query_eval.py checks this), so keyword search can't find it by construction and only the semantic and hybrid modes are expected to. Keyword-style queries live in the maintenance eval's five tasks.
_paraphrase_preregistration: The 20 paraphrase queries, the similarity floor (0.30 cosine) and the keep rule were committed before semantic or hybrid search was run on this set. Keep rule for making hybrid the default search mode, measured against keyword mode at limit 5, status ACTIVE: (a) paraphrase recall@5 mean rises; (b) sentence recall@5 mean does not fall, and sentence MRR mean falls by no more than 0.05; (c) no fewer exact titles rank first. Negative questions are reported, not gated: keyword mode already returns partial matches for unanswerable questions, and the tools tell the agent to check the titles. If hybrid fails the rule, keyword stays the default and semantic and hybrid ship opt-in, with their numbers.

extra_decisions.title: Cache embeddings on disk keyed by content hash
extra_decisions.rationale: Re-embedding unchanged files wastes minutes on large repos. A content-hash cache lets incremental builds skip files whose text has not changed.

extra_decisions.title: Run the test suite on Python 3.10 through 3.12 in CI
extra_decisions.rationale: Users install on all three versions. A matrix build catches version-specific failures before release.

extra_decisions.title: Store synapse weights in a separate SQLite database
extra_decisions.rationale: Synapse writes happen on every tool call. Keeping them out of the main index database avoids lock contention with builds.

extra_decisions.title: Use argparse subcommands for the CLI
extra_decisions.rationale: argparse ships with Python, so the CLI adds no dependency. Subcommands keep build, query and serve options separate.

extra_decisions.title: Serve the graph view from a local HTTP server
extra_decisions.rationale: The graph view needs live updates. A small HTTP server with server-sent events avoids a websocket dependency.

extra_decisions.title: Bind the local server to 127.0.0.1 only
extra_decisions.rationale: The server exposes project structure. Binding to loopback keeps it off the network unless the user opts into server mode.

extra_decisions.title: Decay unused synapse edges on a schedule
extra_decisions.rationale: Edges that are never reinforced should fade so recall reflects current usage, not history.

extra_decisions.title: Limit MCP tool output to a token budget
extra_decisions.rationale: Agents pay for every token a tool returns. Capping output keeps a single call from flooding the context window.

extra_decisions.title: Use release-please for versioning and the changelog
extra_decisions.rationale: Conventional commits drive version bumps and the changelog, so nobody edits version numbers by hand.

extra_decisions.title: Skip files listed in .gitignore when indexing
extra_decisions.rationale: Generated and vendored files add noise and tokens. Respecting .gitignore matches what developers consider source.

extra_decisions.title: Pin ONNX runtime for the local embedder
extra_decisions.rationale: Newer ONNX runtime releases changed thread handling and crashed on some platforms. Pinning keeps embeddings reproducible.

extra_decisions.title: Return compact rows from memory search before full records
extra_decisions.rationale: Progressive disclosure: an index row costs about 80 tokens, a full record several hundred. Agents filter first, then fetch.

extra_decisions.title: Mark decisions stale when their files change
extra_decisions.rationale: A decision tied to code that has since changed may no longer hold. Flagging it stale warns the agent without deleting it.

extra_decisions.title: Write hook errors to a log file instead of stderr
extra_decisions.rationale: Claude Code shows hook stderr to the user. Logging to a file keeps failures diagnosable without cluttering the session.

extra_decisions.title: Hash API tokens before storing them
extra_decisions.rationale: A leaked database must not leak usable tokens. Tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes and compared in constant time.

extra_decisions.title: Rate-limit MCP tool calls per client
extra_decisions.rationale: A runaway agent loop can issue thousands of calls. A per-client token bucket protects the index from overload.

extra_decisions.title: Keep the marketing site as a static export
extra_decisions.rationale: A static Next.js export deploys to Cloudflare Pages with no server to maintain.

extra_decisions.title: Fuse keyword and vector rankings with reciprocal rank fusion
extra_decisions.rationale: BM25 finds exact identifiers; embeddings find paraphrases. Reciprocal rank fusion combines both without tuning score scales.

extra_decisions.title: Use a single writer thread for database writes
extra_decisions.rationale: SQLite allows one writer at a time. Funnelling writes through one thread avoids busy errors under load.

extra_decisions.title: Log a warning when the index is older than the last commit
extra_decisions.rationale: A stale index gives wrong answers silently. A warning tells the user to rebuild.
